title: Observed inundation: no district-valid layer added
resolution: No accepted observation layer. The candidate Global Flood Database uses MODIS-derived observations; its export grid must not be mistaken for native sensor resolution.
coverage_note: Public candidates were reviewed, but no downloadable observation with verified Kozhikode coverage and adequate provenance was accepted. This is a data gap, not evidence that the district was dry.
limitations: Five downloaded Global Flood Database candidate event rasters (DFO 4662, 4665, 4666, 4667 and 4673) did not intersect the district. The opened NRSC/Bhuvan portal did not expose a stable Kerala event-layer download with sufficient metadata for this companion. This is a bounded source review, not a claim that no observed flood data exist.
Cloud, vegetation, brief flooding, sensor resolution and permanent water complicate observed inundation mapping. No candidate layer was substituted with modelled hazard or used to claim validation.
